development.note: Already exposed in prompt-37; used for loss diagnosis and one development check only.

holdout.note: Never evaluated by any earlier study; evaluated exactly once after this file is saved.

coins: Configured symbols currently TRADING on Binance USD-M (WILD unavailable).

costs.fillTiming: next 1m open after the confirming candle closes; stop first on ambiguous bars; gap fills at open

singleCandidateRule.setup: Original unaltered Pine entry_confirmed event (LONG or SHORT). Breakout level L = signal candle close. No entry at the signal itself.
singleCandidateRule.noChase: Within the next 15 one-minute candles, if price travels more than 1.0 original Pine risk beyond L before a retest, the setup is abandoned (missed move, never chased).
singleCandidateRule.invalidation: Abandon if any candle closes beyond the original Pine stop, or no confirmation within 15 candles.
singleCandidateRule.retest: A candle whose adverse extreme returns to within 0.10 ATR of L (LONG low <= L+0.1ATR; SHORT high >= L-0.1ATR).
singleCandidateRule.rejectionConfirmation: On the retest candle or a later candle in the window, a candle closes in the trade direction (body with direction) and back beyond L and beyond EMA9.
singleCandidateRule.momentumAndTrend: At the confirming close: completed 15m Trend Identify equals direction (sideways/opposite skipped); completed 5m EMA9 vs EMA21 agrees; 1m close beyond EMA200; RSI 50-70 LONG / 30-50 SHORT; MACD histogram in direction; candle volume >= 20-candle average.
singleCandidateRule.extensionGuard: Skip if the confirming close is more than 1.5 ATR beyond 1m EMA21.
singleCandidateRule.structureStop: Beyond the lowest low (LONG) / highest high (SHORT) since the signal candle, buffered 0.15 ATR.
singleCandidateRule.costGate: Skip if structure stop distance is below 0.40% of price (round-trip costs would exceed about a third of the risk).
singleCandidateRule.roomGate: Skip if the prior 240-candle opposing extreme lies beyond entry but within 1.0R (target blocked by nearby resistance/support).
singleCandidateRule.target: 1.5R net after modeled entry/exit fees and slippage; maximum hold 240 candles, then exit at close.
singleCandidateRule.portfolio: One open trade at a time across all coins per account; earlier time then configured coin order breaks ties. Account risks 1% of equity per trade at a 000 reference balance; separately report whether  meets Binance minimum notional.

acceptance: Positive in BOTH periods: development mean net R > 0 and holdout mean net R > 0, holdout >= 100 trades, holdout profit factor >= 1.10, 95% UTC-day block-bootstrap lower bound of holdout mean net R > 0. Otherwise reported as not proven; no live change recommended. No thresholds may be changed after holdout results are read.
liveImpact: None. Offline only; no Simulator, settings, history, Telegram or publish changes.
